standaloneLifetimeDecision.rationale: Continuous spawn evaluates to zero under a finite emitter loop, so the standalone snapshot uses the maximum positive, hash-pinned ParticleModuleLifetime value plus the finite burst/loop envelope to preserve the complete visual tail. Emitter delay and the earliest burst are baked into standalone start delay.

signedMirrorDisposition.rationale: Standalone Transform scale requires positive components. The selected raw sample remains signed evidence, while the baked factor uses abs and the importer-compatible 0.01 positive floor; source mirror sign is not claimed as source-exact.

standaloneSizeDecision.rationale: The runtime sourceRecipe particle path uses raw Sprite X/Y or remapped Mesh X/Z/Y size after Element world evaluation; only its Imported-detail fallback synthesizes Mesh depth from the X/Y average. Standalone Mesh/Sprite ignores particle size, so the selected first complete source sample is baked into standalone scale. End scale is used only when a hash-pinned size-over-life module exists and is an explicit linear endpoint approximation.

standaloneDrawableResourceDecision.rationale: The source Sprite has no Base binding. Its first resolved source-order texture carrier is aliased to Base while the original slot remains present; no generic texture or cross-skill resource is introduced.
